(Japanese: '''ポケットモンスターダイヤモンドパール・あつまれポケモン星まつり''' ''{{tt|Pocket Monsters|Pokémon}} Diamond & Pearl: Get Together! Pokémon Star Festival'') is an animated series special that was shown at various planetariums and museums in Japan, being the third of such specials.
